item.title: We promoted developers into architects without informing them
item.description:
📝 Essentially, if you generate code by specifying your requirements instead of specifying your architecture, AI will decide the architecture on your behalf. But AI will never make that call for you, because it doesn’t know your users and it won’t push back on your requirements. That is the architect’s job.
🔗 Read more: https://manidoraisamy.com/developer-to-architect.html

item.title: Signal Is Serious About Protecting Your Privacy
item.description:
📝 This means that we are restricting the latest AI agents built into mobile operating systems from potentially capturing and storing your Signal data. In doing so, your Signal data is captured, then made available to these agentic systems in order to allow them to answer your questions and do your bidding. However, doing so will potentially expose your (and your contacts’) Signal content to these AI agents, and break our privacy guarantees.
🔗 Read more: https://signal.org/blog/protecting-your-privacy/

item.title: Google Workers Tell Their Employer Not to Punish Schools That Don't Want AI
item.description:
